title: Screenspace Radiance Cascades using Depth Moments, Realtime Diffuse GI Showcase
description_preview:
Scene is lit with direct sunlight + screenspace emission + GI calculated in screenspace using depth moments, then fake multi-bounce with temporal feedback.

Unlike bitmasks, depth moments can be aggressively filtered to hide small emission jittering during camera movement. This recording only applies 1 pass of simple blurring to it.
